Package com.saicone.settings

Interface SettingsNode

All Superinterfaces:
com.saicone.types.AnyObject<Object>
All Known Implementing Classes:
ListNode, MapNode, NodeKey, NodeValue, ObjectNode, Settings
public interface SettingsNode extends com.saicone.types.AnyObject<Object>
Interface that represents the global settings memory object.

    asLiteralObject()
    Get the literal object represented by this node, in other words, if the node is a map of nodes, a map of objects wil be return, if the node is a list of nodes, a list of objects will be return, otherwise the value from AnyObject.getValue() will be return.
    This is an expensive operation due every child node or list element will be return as it's literal object recursively, so it's not suggested to use this method frequently.
